name: Lore Data Access
description: Reads trend-points, incidents, patterns, and corrections from Lore via the gateway. Tests the read paths that are live today. corrections returns 501 (stub) — when that flips to 200 this plot will fail, which is the signal that a write/read lifecycle plot needs to be written for corrections.

steps.description: List trend-points — confirms lore is receiving and storing constellation telemetry
List incidents — confirms incident tracking is operational
List patterns — confirms pattern recognition store is accessible
List corrections — stub, returns 501. When this returns 200 the stub is implemented and this plot needs a full corrections lifecycle test.
